a_licence_is_not_a_policy: A DBPR licence is state identity and eligibility evidence for the licensed premises. It never carries or implies a pet policy.

exclusions.CNDO: VACATION_RENTAL_OR_RESORT_RESIDENCE -- a resort condominium unit licensed individually
exclusions.DWEL: VACATION_RENTAL -- a resort / vacation dwelling (whole-home rental) licensed individually
